_meta.notImpactedBy: This lane is SEPARATE from the 115 'kidFriendly: true' entries in manifest.json. Those are regular adult Traditional stories merely flagged kid-safe (full adult prose + audio). Do NOT conflate the two.
statusLifecycle: PROPOSED  - anchor chosen, not yet written
REVIEW    - written, needs editorial pass against KID_STORY_PROMPT.md
NEEDS_REWRITE - written but fails a rule (scripture/safety/length); see notes
REJECTED  - off-prompt (wrong approach), kept as training artifact, will not ship
SUPERSEDED - right approach but replaced by a doctrine-v2 telling; file kept, not pejorative; terminal/non-counting like REJECTED
APPROVED  - passes editorial; ready for audio
AUDIO_PENDING - approved, audio not yet rendered
DONE      - approved + audio rendered + promoted into manifest.json
_meta.promotion: Stories at status DONE are mirrored into assets/stories/manifest.json (kidFriendly: true) by scripts/promote_kid_stories.py.

stories.title: The Cross
stories.reflectionQuestion: What do you think it means to be loved as much as Jesus loves you?
stories.kidSafetyNotes: THE hard story, told via the Joseph method (feedback_kid_god_with_not_cause). LOVE-centered, not suffering-centered: death stated softly ('his breath grew still'); NO nails/blood/gore. Jesus's real words kept ('Father, forgive them'; 'into your hands'). Names that God had NOT left ('there in the dark') and refuses to end in the dark -- ends forward ('Sunday was coming'), gently pointing to Easter (1812). Grounding image: his mother Mary among the watchers (threads to 1824). Mood=hurting: the comfort for a sad child is 'Jesus knows sadness, loves you this much, and God did not leave.' Adam: braver-set centerpiece; reviewed line-by-line.
